operational_flag.verdict: NIGHTLY BLACKOUT NOW FOUR FOR FOUR - ESCALATION IS OVERDUE
operational_flag.coverage_24h: 81 data/ commits in the 24h to 2026-08-01 09:18Z against ~109 expected at the observed 13.2-min cadence (74%); median gap 13.2 min. The 28 missing cycles are exactly the blackout.
operational_flag.pattern: FOURTH consecutive night in the same window with near-identical duration: 367 min (07-28), 368 min (07-29), 357 min (07-30), 364 min (07-31). Four data points within 11 minutes of each other is systematic, not GitHub throttling, and matches the diagnosed mechanism: bot.yml runs a ~5h45m self-looping job under concurrency with cancel-in-progress:false, so the successor sits queued behind the lock. The owner's pre-agreed escalation to an external trigger, scoped to the ~21:40Z-04:15Z handoff, was warranted on three points and is now four.

Measuring from it understates the outage by 83 minutes. Any future automated gap check must exclude non-bot authors.
